status: frozen before future execution; no historical result preregistration claimed
purpose: Establish a technically verified reference before further twelve-class performance comparisons
project_scope: All twelve categories retained; drone protocol recognition retained as subsequent distinct task
principles: Historical code reproduction, literature performance reproduction and target-task adaptation have different claim scopes
Use original 24 outputs only for historical compatibility checks, not as a replacement for the twelve-class project
Do not silently resolve conflicts between paper and code
Do not use development/test results to select which seed to report
Preserve current TorchSig environment, models, datasets and original uploaded evidence
Register protocol amendments with new version before evaluating the affected result
No claim that memorization, a parameter-count match, or constant output under perturbations proves useful recognition

stages.name: Source and evidence audit
stages.result: Pinned sources and local parameter-count checks verified; code/paper conflicts and incomplete environment specification recorded

stages.name: Isolated historical execution environment
stages.next_authorized_work: Prepare and verify the historical reference environment without modifying the working training environment
requirements: Separate environment compatible with original tensorflow==2.4.1, numpy==1.19.2 and published requirements; Python 3.8 is the initial compatibility target
Resolve missing direct dependencies and runner configuration fields, recording exact additions and reasons
Record pip check, import checks, platform, CPU/GPU availability and all resolved versions
Resolve executable launcher/version configuration rather than silently patching scientific behavior
Start with CPU model construction; historical WSL/GPU compatibility is an independent check, not assumed
stages.pass: Original model and runner dependencies import; original 1024x2/24 model constructs; exact environment lock and source hashes recorded
stages.failure_action: Record concrete incompatibility and produce a separately named compatibility adaptation; no exact reproduction claim

stages.name: Direct TensorFlow versus PyTorch numerical parity
stages.first_comparison: Original 1024 samples, 24 outputs; then separately the project adapter with 4096 samples and 12 outputs
requirements: Use actual pinned original TensorFlow model functions, not a second handwritten substitute
Transfer identical realized weights, explicitly transposing Conv1D and Dense kernels
Use identical deterministic zero, sinusoidal and complex-noise input fixtures with recorded hashes
Compare named intermediate activations, population variance pooling, logits/probabilities and gradients of a fixed documented loss
Test each conversion independently and in the full model; match SELU, biases and channels-last/channels-first semantics
Run first in CPU float32; treat GPU differences separately
Compare a single optimizer step only after matching clipping semantics, epsilon placement, moments and initialization
stages.predeclared_numerical_rule: For forward and gradient arrays require elementwise abs(error) <= 1e-6 + 1e-4*abs(TensorFlow value), finite results, and matching shapes; record maximum absolute and relative errors even when passing
stages.pass: All fixtures and seeds meet numerical rule; optimizer-step equivalence either verified or explicitly classified as a different optimizer experiment
stages.failure_action: Localize and correct the earliest mismatching layer or update; do not start performance comparisons

stages.name: Historical reference reproduction
stages.primary_profile: Reproduction of pinned executable code, not a claim to reproduce the conflicting text procedure
stages.dataset: Original RadioML 2018.01A HDF5, original 24-column order, original published train/test index files
data_requirements: Verify HDF5 and index-file hashes, row bounds, duplicate indices, split overlap, class/SNR distributions
Record actual raw amplitude statistics; do not add RMS normalization
Keep original 1024 samples without resampling; audit converted TFRecord values against source rows
Measure actual batch label/SNR composition after the original converter and loader
scope_notes: Project seed controls are an explicit reproducibility addition because upstream does not fully specify them
Upstream test split is displayed during fit and is historical benchmark/development data, never the project's sealed final test
Original callback defaults beyond the listed fields must be preserved from the pinned framework and logged
If runtime/storage budget prevents completion, classify result as an incomplete reproduction, not as a successful baseline
A paper-description profile with batch 32 and validation-based callbacks is distinct; never substitute its result silently for the primary code profile
stages.pass: Code-faithful execution completes with all artifacts and noncollapsed learning; publication-level accuracy agreement remains a separate assessment because code and text differ
stages.failure_action: Document failure or unresolved divergence; no target-task winner or literature reproduction claim

stages.name: Twelve-class task transfer
requirements: Keep all twelve project categories with explicit mathematical definitions and parameter domains
Record that moving from RadioML24 to TorchSig12 changes task, generators and input distribution together; this is not an isolated architecture experiment
Reverify TensorFlow and PyTorch parity for the 4096-sample, 12-output configuration
Run the same training-only memorization selection under the verified reference implementation
Declare train/validation/development splits and sampling unit before new training
Compare architecture or input representation in separate experiments, with matched data and a justified verified optimization protocol
stages.pass: Twelve-class adapted reference passes direct parity and learning checks, with all adaptations and limitations named
stages.failure_action: Investigate task-transfer changes before introducing another architecture

stages.name: Optional controlled batch-composition diagnosis
stages.state: deferred; hypothesis not a selected solution

fixed_design_if_activated_without_amendm.source: train split only; signal SNR >=15 dB; noise has no SNR
conditions: random permutation without replacement per epoch
two examples per class per batch, shuffled within each class per epoch
fixed_design_if_activated_without_amendm.exposure_control: Both conditions visit every selected example exactly once in each 10-update epoch; no oversampling or dropping examples
fixed_design_if_activated_without_amendm.initial_weights: Cloned identical state per paired seed
fixed_design_if_activated_without_amendm.optimizer: PyTorch Adam eps=1e-8, no clipping or scheduler; diagnostic profile, not original optimizer reproduction
fixed_design_if_activated_without_amendm.primary_measure: Cross entropy over all 240 selected training examples after update 1000
fixed_design_if_activated_without_amendm.interpretation: Report paired final-loss differences for all three seeds. Direction consistent in all pairs is supportive evidence limited to this diagnosis, not proof of general recognition improvement. No seed selection.

stages.name: Independent generator and real-reception validation
stages.prerequisite: G4 and a frozen candidate protocol
requirements: Current viewed test sets remain development references
Use an independently implemented generator and real captures; a fresh seed alone is not cross-generator validation
Split real recordings by capture/session/transmitter as appropriate; adjacent or derived windows stay grouped
Predeclare primary twelve-class macro-F1, class recalls, confusion matrices and SNR/bandwidth/offset strata
Report seed variability separately from test-sample or capture uncertainty; repeated predictions of the same examples are not independent new samples
Specify application-dependent absolute acceptance criteria and unknown-signal handling before unsealing the final evaluation
Freeze code, preprocessing, weights and class map before final evaluation; no label-dependent frequency alignment
Drone protocol labels require separate validated protocol examples and competing non-drone signals; modulation prediction alone is insufficient
stages.pass: Only after preregistered operational criteria and independent validation are satisfied; no universal accuracy target invented in this audit

current_allowed_conclusion: The twelve-class port can memorize a small balanced selection on CPU and user GPU. The full-training collapse is unexplained. No real-world or drone recognition performance established.
